resources.string: Scan a packaged food barcode to see its ingredients, nutrition facts and declared allergens explained in plain language.
Scan the barcode, or type the number.
See what the label declares: ingredients, nutrition per 100 g and per serving, and allergens.
Every fact shows where it came from and how it was checked.
There is no overall score yet. Scores stay off until an expert-reviewed method is published, and missing data is never guessed.
Free to use without an account. Brands cannot pay to change what you see.
We\'ll point out these allergens when a label declares them. This uses the label only and is not a guarantee.
